senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) he, it; she; it is &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:3">Snh. III, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 24b:19">24ᵇ</cite>) if he has no trade <he>אלא הוא</he> (Y. ed., <cite ref="Eruvin 82a:5">Erub. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>היא</he>) except this (gambling &c.); <he>יש לו אומנות שלא הוא</he> (<he>היא</he>) if he has a trade besides this (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80).—<he>הוא</he>—<he>הוא</he>, <he>היא</he>—<he>היא</he> it is the same, i.e. there is no difference between the two.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:2:9">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵇ</cite> <he>היא היא</he> both are equally precious.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:13">Gen. R. s. 9</cite>, end <he>הוא מאד הוא אדם</he> the word <cite ref="M00005"><he>מאד</he></cite> has the same letters as <he>אדם</he>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:1">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא ביאת אורו הוא</he> perhaps it is (means) the arrival of his day, v. <cite ref="A00842"><he>אוֹר</he> II</cite>; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:8">Shebi. III, 8</cite> <he>עושה הוא</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:5">IV, 5</cite> <he>מכסה הוא</he>, Y. ed. <he>עוֹשֵׂהוּ</he>, <he>מְכַסֵּהוּ</he>; ib. X, 6 <he>מזכה הוא</he>; Ms. M., <cite ref="Gittin 37a:13">Gitt. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מְזַכֵּהוּ</he>.]—<he>ולא היא</he> but it is not so (it has a different reason &c.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:4">Peah II, 4</cite> <he>כל ש׳ אוכל</he> whatever is eatable &c.; a. fr.—

units: Shebi. X, 6 כל שהוא; Gitt. l. c. כל שֶׁהוּ; a. fr.—ספר היא the Book Hi, name of a Pentateuch scroll in the Temple in which היא occurs nine times (for the archaic הִוא), whereas in others it appears eleven times (v.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 34:11">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXIV</cite>, ed. Schechter).
